statement: The exact intrinsic-to-joint wild H2 map, its complete retained coordinate rows and kernels, the remaining E82 quotient character, and the empty intrinsic class-two preimages of E80’s obstructed joint family.
manuscript_passages: Section51.16, folios733v–736v, scans172–178, formulas371–379; Part E(c),(d), follow-up(4)
notes: The actual coefficient map A3->L->A retains the index-nine image lattice. Its natural H2 map has exactly diagonal C3 image in C3^2.
The obstruction naturality square is proved with the actual central extension maps and the index-two error omega/2. In joint Hall coordinates the target class is exactly (Delta R,Delta S) modulo3.
E80 family members with N+M not congruent2 modulo3 have no intrinsic class-two preimage. No sufficiency assertion is made for the compatible members.

The complete four unit-character rows are derived from actual cusp divisors and the integral gluing U=(v,-u). The actual E78 source marking transport preserves the E74 coefficient matrices by its explicit CM conjugation comparison.
The full 4x330 Hall map and the actual source H2 maps are saved. In the 93 retained positive Smith coordinates, the diagonal character is b89+b91+2b92 modulo3; all three are C27 coordinates.
The intrinsic kernel is C3^63 x C9^24 x C27^6 with explicit inverse b89=3k-b91-2b92. All6561 changed-coordinate triples are checked.

All nine E82 cusp-family maps are killed, proved geometrically and checked on all405 columns. On the exact residual C3^11 x C9, the map is eta9+eta10, with kernel C3^10 x C9 and explicit inverse eta9=-eta10.
The full compatible class-two image and its fibres remain the separately reserved E85 task; E23 is not declared solved.
